oauth.grants.password: OAuth 2.0 grant type (resource owner password credentials). Not the same as the Password field label.
oauth.fields.grant: Label of the picker for the OAuth 2.0 grant type.
oauth.fields.issuer: Label of the field for the OpenID Connect issuer address.
oauth.fields.callbackTitle: {{url}} is an address. Tooltip of the callback address field.
oauth.fields.scope: OAuth 2.0 scope: the list of permissions requested, separated by spaces.
oauth.fields.credentialsIn: Label of the picker that chooses how the client credentials are sent to the token endpoint.
oauth.fields.credentialsHeader: Option: send the client ID and secret in an HTTP Basic Authorization header. Keep Basic.
oauth.fields.credentialsBody: Option: send the client ID and secret in the body of the token request.
oauth.fields.headerPrefix: Label of the field for the word before the token in the Authorization header. The default is Bearer.
oauth.discover: Button that fills the endpoints from the issuer address.
oauth.discoverTitle: Tooltip of the Discover button. Keep the path /.well-known/openid-configuration unchanged.
oauth.getToken: Button that requests a token. Short.
oauth.clearToken: Button that forgets the stored token.
oauth.deviceCode: Text that introduces a short code the user types on another page. It ends with a colon.
oauth.noToken: Status line under the token buttons when no token is stored.
oauth.signInNeeded: Error shown when a request needs an OAuth 2.0 token that has not been fetched. Auth tab and Get token are interface labels; use the same words as the translations of those labels.
oauth.signInForEnvironment: Error shown when the stored token belongs to another environment. Auth tab and Get token are interface labels.
oauth.popup.refused: {{reason}} is text returned by the provider and may be in English.
